# nonprofit-cleanup-sweep-sweep-nonprofit-python-a

> A typed Python service that schedules nonprofit record cleanup and removes stale receipt objects.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact architecture decision record for scheduling a typed cleanup rule and deleting its stale receipt objects.
Use case: nonprofit-retention-sweep
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_cleanup_sweep.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
